specialties.name: Apothecary

triggers.effect: your healing is never halved by Burn, and any unit you heal loses 1 Burn as the dressing goes on.

specialties.name: Torch-Bearer
specialties.intent: You carry the only light anyone has, which means you decide what the party can see and exactly where the enemy will aim.

triggers.effect: every ally within 2 hexes gains +1 Vision for the rest of the Battle

Dropped stats: dodge -5; vision +3. Parked abilities: onAttach: while attached, the hero you follow gains +2 Vision; it lapses the moment you detach or are downed. | 2026-08-17: third stat vision +2 — the one place Vision genuinely is the specialty.

specialties.name: Porter
specialties.intent: You carry what the heroes cannot.

Dropped stats: precision -1; dodge -5. specialties.name: Militia
specialties.intent: Someone put a spear in your hands last week and told you where to stand, and you have not left that hex since.

triggers.effect: gain +1 Armor for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Civilian/Soldier, RENAMED to Militia — Soldier is a badge in HoBaT (badge.soldier), a classification any hero may hold regardless of class, so the specialty cannot own the name. The soldier ROLE tag and the soldier identity are granted by badge.soldier, never by this specialty; Militia keeps only the drilled-farmhand stat block. Militia is also the fourth civilian role named in the deployment design. | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Dropped stats: movement -1; health +2. Parked abilities: onAllyDeath: if the ally died within 2 hexes of you, lose 5 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle. | 2026-08-20: "if you begin the Battle adjacent to any ally" was a deployment-position check. Unconditional.

specialties.name: Trickster
specialties.intent: You have never won a fight, but you have survived every one of them, and the enemy keeps swinging at where you just were.
specialties.source: Hell-TCG Civilian/Trickster (dodge/reach/slots block rebuilt; Reach cut because it does nothing for a melee civilian) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. specialties.name: Archer
specialties.intent: You hunted for the pot, not for glory, and the difference has never mattered less than it does right now.

triggers.effect: gain +5 Accuracy for the rest of the Battle

specialties.name: Archivist
specialties.intent: You have read about every one of these things, and knowing what it is turns out to be worth more than being able to fight it.

triggers.effect: every ally within 4 hexes gains +2 damage

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Lorekeeper/Archivist (the draw-flooding identity has no meaning without The Hand; rebuilt on Vision, reveal and creature-tag bonuses) | 2026-08-17: was a battle-start snapshot of enemies in Vision, which shows nothing at deployment. specialties.name: Sage
specialties.intent: You are eighty years old and cannot lift a shield, but the party's magic runs deeper for every hour you stay upright on the field.

triggers.effect: the party's Magic sum and Spirit sum each count 1 higher

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Lorekeeper/Sage (the +1 Magic ports directly and is the point: three civilians in the flex slot can carry a party's Magic sum, and losing one takes it back) | 2026-08-17 trim: three stats, no negatives, one ability. Parked abilities: onDeath: the +1 Magic and +1 Spirit you contributed to the party sums are lost the instant you fall, and every ally within 4 hexes gains 2 Weak. | 2026-08-17 quality pass: replaced a placeholder aura with a distinct effect. | 2026-08-20: a "usable only if" gate on your own or the target's state is not a thing — nothing reads a Health threshold or an event history to decide whether a power is legal. the above/below half Health branch is cut. The Sage simply raises both sums.

specialties.name: Remembrancer
specialties.intent: You are the one who writes down who died and where, and the party fights better knowing the page gets filled in either way.

triggers.effect: gain +2 Crit for the rest of the Battle

specialties.source: Hell-TCG Lorekeeper/Chronicler, RENAMED to Remembrancer — Chronicler is the name of the game's narrating voice in HoBaT and is reserved for it; a specialty sharing that name would read as the narrator being a unit on the map. It was a per-tag ledger written during the Battle — nothing remembers what you have killed, and nothing matches a tag against a remembered one. The kill now pays a flat +2 Crit for the rest of the Battle.

powers.name: Poultice

powers.name: Stretcher Run

powers.description: Free. Gain +2 Movement and +10 Dodge until the end of your next Turn.
powers.intent: Whatever you were carrying is somebody else’s problem for one Turn.
powers.source: new 2026-08-20: replaces power.porter.hand-it-over, which needed items to move between heroes and onto the ground. | 2026-08-20: standardised to "Free." A trinket that does not use your action is a power and appears in the power list, so it uses the same word powers use. The stamina cost is a field, not prose.
